meta.name: commit
meta.description: Create git commits with user approval and no Claude attribution

copy.tagline: 生成 git 提交信息并确认后提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规范地提交代码变更
copy.tagline_en: Generate git commit messages and commit with approval
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently need to commit code changes with proper messages

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: Claude 会帮你把本次对话中做的代码改动整理成 git 提交。它会先检查改了什么、规划提交方案，然后请你确认，确认后自动执行 git add 和 git commit，并生成一份开发过程记录。
howto.when: 当你完成代码修改后，直接对 Claude 说“帮我提交”或“commit”时触发。

say.note: Claude 会检查改动并给出提交计划。

say.text: 把修改的文件分成两个提交。
say.note: Claude 会按逻辑分组并分别提交。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you create git commits for the changes made during the session. It reviews changes, plans commits, asks for your approval, then executes git add and commit, and generates a reasoning file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to commit changes, e.g., 'commit' or 'help me commit'.

say_en.note: Claude will review and propose a commit plan.

say_en.text: Split the changes into two commits.
say_en.note: Claude will group files logically and commit separately.
